source: SELECT type_name AS name, logical_type, type_category AS category FROM duckdb_types() WHERE internal

probes.set: SELECT CAST($1 AS <left>) UNION ALL SELECT CAST($2 AS <right>)

unavailable.name: array
unavailable.reason: Binder Error: ARRAY type requires exactly two type modifiers

unavailable.name: enum
unavailable.reason: Binder Error: ENUM type requires at least one argument

unavailable.name: list
unavailable.reason: Binder Error: LIST type requires exactly one type modifier

unavailable.name: map
unavailable.reason: Binder Error: MAP type requires exactly two type modifiers: key type and value type

unavailable.name: null
unavailable.reason: Non-concrete catalog type; a prepared NULL may be represented as INTEGER

unavailable.name: row
unavailable.reason: Binder Error: STRUCT type requires at least one child type

unavailable.name: struct
unavailable.reason: Binder Error: STRUCT type requires at least one child type

unavailable.name: union
unavailable.reason: Binder Error: UNION type requires at least one type modifier
